title: Book Spellbound Cottage | Rosemary Beach Vacation House Rental | Rosemary Beach ® – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: Step into coastal charm at Spellbound Cottage, a beautiful Rosemary Beach® vacation rental. Enjoy elegant design, modern comforts, and a perfect location near the beach!
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

This artfully designed home by Tim McNamara, previously featured on the pages of Coastal Living magazine, combines simple forms with over 1,500sf of exquisite exterior living space. Located on a large corner lot, this lovely home has picturesque views of the shady greenery of a arbor inspired pocket park. The open floor plan with adjoining front and side porches accessible through multiple sets of French doors creates an inviting respite soaked with natural light. A cozy outdoor fireplace casts a rosy glow of warmth for evening sundowners or casual entertaining. More formal dining can be enjoyed beneath the contemporary chandelier with food inspired by the zesty contemporary kitchen with alphabetically etched glass doors that inspired the cottages namesake, Spellbound Cottage. This recently renovated cottage combines practicality with a definite wow factor including SONOS streaming music throughout. Three bedrooms are each served by beautiful private bathrooms and balconies that are ideal for welcoming the fresh morning breeze that heralds each new day. Looming over all is a lofty corner look-out tower with a "Mary Poppins" view over the roofs of Rosemary Beach and adjacent to this unique home is a generous two-car carport with a screened porch above.

SPRING BREAK AND SUMMER - HOME RENTS 7 NIGHTS, SUNDAY - SUNDAY

Features

- SONOS Streaming Music System Throughout

- Formal living area on 1st Floor

- 1st Floor Master Bedroom (Queen Bed) with En suite

- 2nd Floor Master Bedroom (King Bed) with En suite

- 2nd Floor Master Bedroom (Queen Bed) with En suite

- 4 Complimentary Adult Bikes

- Steps to Cabana Pool

- 1,500sf of outdoor living space

- Stainless Steel, High Efficiency Appliances

SPRING BREAK AND SUMMER - RENTS FULL WEEK, SATURDAY TO SATURDAY.

Amenities

- High-Speed Internet

- Free Adult Bikes

Parking

- Corner lot with bountiful street parking
